verdict.rationale: Cake offers an MCP server that lets AI assistants query cap table data in plain English, but this access is explicitly read-only, covering only viewing shareholders, vesting, SAFEs, etc. There is no evidence of write capabilities (issuing shares, managing vesting, capital raises, certificates) via API, and probes for a public OpenAPI/REST API returned 404s, indicating no full API parity with the UI. Missing for 10: write/mutation endpoints via API, a documented general-purpose API/OpenAPI spec, and evidence that all UI actions (raises, certificates, board approvals) can be performed via API.
